open_points.subject: load_configuration
open_points.text: load_configuration: [RETURN_SHAPE] MUST answer, when every check passes, a LoadedConfiguration holding the store path and the backup location as the check of the store and the backup location apart resolved them and each listener address as a ListenAddress of its host without brackets and its port as an integer, the service API's address None for an owner-only start; it MUST keep the checked secrets in the module's memory, from which the give functions answer them, and MUST put no secret into its answer.
open_points.other_text: load_configuration: [ORCHESTRATION] MUST judge an address item well formed exactly when read_listen_address answers a ListenAddress for its text, and MUST put that ListenAddress into its LoadedConfiguration, parsing no address in any other way.
open_points.question: Must read_listen_address's imported contract guarantee that every returned ListenAddress already has its host without brackets, or must load_configuration be allowed to normalize the returned address instead of putting that ListenAddress into LoadedConfiguration unchanged?
